Yes, it would be covered by the Plant Care Guarantee, which runs for 30 days from delivery (90 days if you're a Leafy Plus member and the plant was ordered while your membership was active). If the plant dies or declines significantly despite reasonable care, we send one free replacement. Significant decline means losing more than a third of its leaves, stem or root rot, or collapse. Yellowing of one or two older leaves in the first two weeks is normal transplant stress and isn't covered on its own.

To claim, go to "My Orders" within the window and upload at least two photos (whole plant and a close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review within 2 business days, and you don't need to send the plant back.

Since the pot is cracked, don't repot into non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days, as that voids coverage. If you'd like help keeping the plant stable in the meantime, a Plant Care Specialist can give free advice by chat or email. Would you like me to escalate your damaged pot report to a Support Lead?
